title: Per-pass soundness lemmas for micromega's tauto_checker
intent: Soundness of micromega's tauto checker is reduced to the two pass lemmas the checker is built from — xcnf_correct for the formula-to-CNF translation and cnf_checker_sound for the per-clause oracle — so the top-level theorem is a two-step composition with no case analysis of its own.

parent.name: tauto_checker_sound
parent.statement: Lemma tauto_checker_sound : forall t  w, tauto_checker t w = true -> forall env, eval_f e_rtyp (eval env)  t.

children.name: xcnf_correct
children.statement:
Lemma xcnf_correct : forall (k: kind) (f : @GFormula Term rtyp Annot unit k)  pol env,
      eval_cnf env (xcnf pol f) -> hold k (eval_f e_rtyp (eval env) (if pol then f else NOT f)).
children.closed_by: induction f; the A case applies normalise_correct / negate_correct, the AND/OR/NOT cases close from the IHs and hold_e* lemmas, and the IMPL/IFF cases delegate to xcnf_impl / xcnf_iff
children.note: Pass 1: correctness of the formula-to-CNF translation xcnf; the two structural cases IMPL and IFF are factored out as the induction helpers xcnf_impl (1791) and xcnf_iff (1853). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: If the CNF of xcnf pol f is valid in env, then f (negated when pol = false) holds.

children.name: cnf_checker_sound
children.statement: Lemma cnf_checker_sound : forall t  w, cnf_checker t w = true -> forall env, eval_cnf  env  t.
children.closed_by: induction t; per clause case_eq (checker a w), generalize (@checker_sound _ _ H env), rewrite <- make_conj_impl, tauto
children.note: Pass 2: correctness of the CNF oracle checker, lifting the per-clause section hypothesis checker_sound (2021) to a whole CNF via make_conj_impl (Refl.v). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: If cnf_checker accepts witnesses w for the CNF t, then t is valid in every environment.

applicability.goal_shape: A soundness theorem for a certified (reflexive) procedure built as sequential passes over an intermediate representation: here `tauto_checker t w = true -> forall env, eval_f e_rtyp (eval env) t`, where tauto_checker is `cnf_checker (xcnf true f) w` and each pass has its own correctness lemma stated over the shared predicate `eval_cnf env (xcnf pol f)`.
applicability.use_when: the procedure is a composition of passes whose correctness lemmas already exist or are worth stating separately, and the top-level proof only has to line the passes up (an `unfold` and a `change`, then `apply`/`eapply`); each pass's statement is self-contained in terms of the intermediate predicate it shares with the next pass.
applicability.avoid_when: the passes' statements do not share an intermediate predicate (then the glue must reason inside a pass, not just compose); a pass has no independent, reusable statement worth naming; or the top-level proof must do genuine work in the middle rather than only compose the two lemmas.

claims.claim: The top-level theorem is 8 lines of glue composing 2 direct lemmas, whose child sites span 123 and 21 lines; below the main theorem is a chain of 6 project lemmas, xcnf_correct down to add_term_correct.
claims.evidence: parent site theories/micromega/Tauto.v#L2060-L2067 (8 lines); children xcnf_correct #L1894-L2016 (123 lines) and cnf_checker_sound #L2035-L2055 (21 lines); the depth-6 chain tauto_checker_sound -> xcnf_correct -> xcnf_impl -> or_cnf_correct -> or_clause_cnf_correct -> or_clause_correct -> add_term_correct is visible at #L2065, #L1987, #L1813, #L1681, #L1634, #L1598

claims.claim: tauto_checker_sound is declared at line 2060 of theories/micromega/Tauto.v.

CompCert's transf_c_program_match chains one per-pass `transf_program_match` lemma per compilation pass — SimplExprproof through Asmgenproof — the same per-callee-lemma composition this entry records.

metrics.how_counted: glue = tauto_checker_sound (lines 2060-2067); children = xcnf_correct (1894-2016) and cnf_checker_sound (2035-2055), declaration included in each; neither child closes by a single automation tactic — both are inductions over a formula/CNF with per-case rewrites

consequences: The glue concentrates everything into aligning the two pass lemmas: it unfolds tauto_checker and `change`s `eval_f ... t` into `eval_f ... (if true then t else TT isProp)` so that xcnf_correct's conclusion and cnf_checker_sound's hypothesis both mention `eval_cnf env (xcnf true t)`. The obligations move down: xcnf_correct must hold for the polarity `true` that tauto_checker fixes, and cnf_checker_sound is parametric in the oracle's soundness, which is the section hypothesis `checker_sound` (the checker itself is assumed sound, not proved here). Failure mode: if a pass's correctness statement does not line up with the next pass's input, the glue gains a pile of `change`/rewrites or the composition breaks entirely.
